sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests the meaning of the word enjoin in immigration law. The government says it means to stop an action. The detainee says it means to stop or start an action. This definition controls which courts can review detention orders.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The definition of enjoin determines which courts can review detention. It controls access to independent decisionmakers for prolonged detention. It shapes the balance between executive power and individual liberty.
